DXVK with adapter-group patches (UNOFFICIAL)
============================================

Unofficial DXVK build for Supreme Commander / Forged Alliance dual-screen under
Wine/Proton. Not affiliated with DXVK or FAF; report problems at
https://github.com/Huppie/dxvk-adapter-groups

Install (faf-linux)
-------------------
Close the game, then:
  cd ~/faf-linux/prefix/drive_c/windows/syswow64
  cp d3d9.dll d3d9.dll.bak
  cp /path/to/x32/d3d9.dll d3d9.dll

Other Proton: replace files/lib/wine/dxvk/i386-windows/d3d9.dll in the Proton
folder (back it up first).

With an integrated GPU as well (most Ryzen machines), add to your DXVK config
(faf-linux: ~/faf-linux/dxvk-local.conf):
  dxvk.hideIntegratedGraphics = True

Enable the second screen
------------------------
In-game: Options -> Video -> Secondary Adapter -> pick your second monitor's
resolution, then restart the game. Changing some other options (anti-aliasing,
for example) can reset Secondary Adapter to disabled; check it first if the
second screen goes dark.

Roll back
---------
  cp ~/faf-linux/prefix/drive_c/windows/syswow64/d3d9.dll.bak \
     ~/faf-linux/prefix/drive_c/windows/syswow64/d3d9.dll

Source: upstream DXVK (https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk, zlib license, see
DXVK-LICENSE) plus the patches in patches/.
